description: Patch-level bumps of Apache NiFi automerge here: the Molecule run logs in with the credentials the role configures, asserts that the process reports the version defaults/main.yml pins, and fails if files/conf/ stops matching that image - which is the by-hand reconciliation docs/updating-nifi.md describes, turned into a gate.

Measured before enabling this: across 2.7.0 -> 2.7.1 -> 2.7.2 and 1.28.0 -> 1.28.1 the shipped configuration and startup scripts are byte-identical, and restarting a 2.7.0 instance on 2.7.2 over the same conf/state/repository directories keeps its credentials and logs no flow differences. Minor and major bumps stay human-reviewed pull requests.
